name: labs/lewbert__talos-2d-transfer
title: Zolix ZC300 XYR sample stage (talos.hal.devices.zolix:ZolixXYRStage)
intro: Zolix ZC300 XYR sample stage (talos.hal.devices.zolix:ZolixXYRStage), adapted from lewbert/talos-2d-transfer. It reads `x_um`, `y_um`, `r_deg`, `moving` and 2 more; runs `move_abs` and `stop_motion`. `move_abs`: move the stage to an absolute X/Y position (and R when given) and wait, bounded by the request deadline, until the controller reports no axis moving; the position it reports is returned. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
